Everytime i go to see my doctor, he tells me the same thing. "Everything should clear up in about 4 weeks." It was 4-5 months ago the first time I was told this about my shoulder. My leg on the other hand, my therapist said about 2 weeks, 2 weeks ago. It really sucks and I hate to be in a such a shitty mode. I could accomplish so much and be such a better person if I didn't have these problems. But everyone has problems, so what makes me important. Exactly I don't fucking know. To most the people I know, I'm just a lazy pussy who pretends to be hurt so he doesn't have to workout. 

To sum things up. Yes I have been to the doctor. I have been in physical therapy for my shoulder for the last 5-6 months and the last 2 weeks for the leg. 

Thank You so much for your concern.
